title: 八成中国工厂挤在园区：零碳园区试点已铺开，五年换掉煤电底座？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: In Inomongolia, a region deep in inland China, you'll find cows, grasslands, this little buddy,
segments.zh: 在中国内陆深处的内蒙古，你会看到奶牛、草原、这个小家伙，

segments.en: and a possible model for a carbon-free future.
segments.zh: 以及一个可能实现零碳未来的模式。

segments.en: China is the world's largest exporter of goods, 80% of Chinese factories, which manufacture everything from your smartphone
segments.zh: 中国是全球最大的商品出口国，80%的中国工厂生产从智能手机

segments.en: to industrial chemicals to Labubus, sit inside industrial parks, especially zone districts that draw on a shared power supply.
segments.zh: 到工业化学品再到拉布布等各种产品，这些工厂位于工业园区内，尤其是共享电力供应的专区。

segments.en: These industrial clusters are responsible for approximately 50% of China's GDP, but they come at a cost.
segments.zh: 这些产业集群贡献了中国约50%的GDP，但也付出了代价。

segments.en: China is still the carbon emitters globally.
segments.zh: 中国仍是全球碳排放的主要来源。

segments.en: Many Chinese factories use major coal plants to produce the products that we see around the world, but now China is trying to shift away from that.
segments.zh: 许多中国工厂使用大型燃煤电厂生产我们在世界各地看到的产品，但现在中国正试图摆脱这种模式。

segments.en: And the concept that they've focused in on is this new concept, which is the zero carbon industrial park.
segments.zh: 他们聚焦的概念是这个新概念——零碳工业园区。

segments.en: In March, 2026, China set a target to designate 100 zero carbon industrial parks over the next five years.
segments.zh: 2026年3月，中国设定了在未来五年内指定100个零碳工业园区的目标。

segments.en: These planned districts of factories are meant to share renewable power supply.
segments.zh: 这些规划中的工厂区旨在共享可再生能源供应。

segments.en: Meanwhile, private companies have paved a head with their own versions.
segments.zh: 与此同时，民营企业已用自身方案取得领先。

segments.en: We are not zero industrial park. We are 100% use renewable energy as our feedstock.
segments.zh: 我们不是零碳产业园，而是100%使用可再生能源作为原料。
